hero_y = 244
T(draw, (M + 40, hero_y), "5.56", H440(), NV)
hero_baseline = hero_y + tbase("5.56", H440())  # 244 + 439 = 683
hero_r = M + 40 + tw("5.56", H440())  # right edge of number

# Vertical accent bar alongside hero number
BOX(draw, (M - 12, hero_y + 78, M, hero_baseline + 6), fill=EL)

# "BILLION" — baseline-aligned with hero
bill_y = hero_baseline - tbase("BILLION", H150())  # 683 - 150 = 533
T(draw, (hero_r + 36, bill_y), "BILLION", H150(), TL)

# Supporting line
sup_y = hero_baseline + 28
T(draw, (M + 40, sup_y), "global internet users worldwide, representing", B22(), ST)

# "68%" stat
p68_y = sup_y + 40
T(draw, (M + 40, p68_y), "68%", H130(), NV)
p68_r = M + 40 + tw("68%", H130())
T(draw, (p68_r + 18, p68_y + 24), "of the world's population", B22(), ST)
T(draw, (p68_r + 18, p68_y + 54), "— roughly 1 in every 1.5 people on Earth", I18(), GM)

# --- CHINA + INDIA CALL-OUT PANELS ---
pnl_w = (CW - 48) // 2
pnl_h = 200
pnl_y = p68_y + 108 + 30  # leave breathing room after 68% section

# China panel
BOX(draw, (M, pnl_y, M + pnl_w, pnl_y + pnl_h), fill=WT, outline=GL, w=1)
BOX(draw, (M, pnl_y, M + pnl_w, pnl_y + 6), fill=EL)
T(draw, (M + 32, pnl_y + 24), "CHINA", T28(), NV)
cn_y = pnl_y + 56
T(draw, (M + 32, cn_y), "~1.09", H110(), NV)
cn_r = M + 32 + tw("~1.09", H110())
T(draw, (cn_r + 14, cn_y + 20), "BILLION", H48(), TL)
T(draw, (M + 32, pnl_y + 160), "ONLINE POPULATION  ·  76% PENETRATION", M14(), GD)

# India panel
ix = M + pnl_w + 48
BOX(draw, (ix, pnl_y, ix + pnl_w, pnl_y + pnl_h), fill=WT, outline=GL, w=1)
BOX(draw, (ix, pnl_y, ix + pnl_w, pnl_y + 6), fill=TL)
T(draw, (ix + 32, pnl_y + 24), "INDIA", T28(), NV)
in_y = pnl_y + 56
T(draw, (ix + 32, in_y), "~900", H110(), NV)
in_r = ix + 32 + tw("~900", H110())
T(draw, (in_r + 14, in_y + 20), "MILLION", H48(), TL)
T(draw, (ix + 32, pnl_y + 160), "ONLINE POPULATION  ·  62% PENETRATION", M14(), GD)

# Combined statement
comb_y = pnl_y + pnl_h + 36
T(draw, (M, comb_y), "Together: nearly", B20(), ST)
cmb = "2 BILLION"
cmb_w = tw(cmb, H90())
T(draw, (M + 188, comb_y - 8), cmb, H90(), TL)
T(draw, (M + 192 + cmb_w, comb_y + 8), "online users — over one-third of the global digital population", B20(), ST)

# --- SECTION: PENETRATION RATES (THE ANALYTICAL CENTERPIECE) ---
sec1_y = comb_y + 78

T(draw, (M, pen_title_y), "INTERNET PENETRATION RATES BY COUNTRY", T28(), NV)
T(draw, (M, pen_title_y + 34), "Percentage of population with internet access  ·  2025 estimates  ·  Ranked by penetration rate", B16(), GD)
RULE(draw, M, pen_title_y + 58, M + 520, pen_title_y + 58, EL, 2)

    ("China",          76, "~1.09B"),

    ("Nigeria",        52, " ~115M"),
]

bx = M + 280       # bar start x
br = W - M - 180   # bar end x
bw = br - bx       # bar width
bh = 30            # bar height
bgap = 16          # bar gap

ref_y1 = chart_top + n * (bh + bgap) + 14

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Global Internet Usage Poster — Spatial Metrics philosophy.
A1 portrait, museum-grade execution.
3508 x 4967 px (A1 at 150 DPI)
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import os, math

# ── Canvas ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
W, H = 3508, 4967
canvas = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), "#F7F9FB")
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)

# ── Font engine ───────────────────────────────────────────────
FD = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"
_cache = {}
def ff(name, size):
    k = (name, size)
    if k not in _cache:
        _cache[k] = ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FD, name), size)
    return _cache[k]

# ── Palette ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
NV  = "#091424"   # deep navy (anchoring tone)
ST  = "#1E3048"   # steel
TL  = "#0D7377"   # teal (bridge tone)
CY  = "#00ACC1"   # cyan
EL  = "#0077BE"   # electric blue (accent)
BG  = "#F7F9FB"   # near-white background
WT  = "#FFFFFF"
GL  = "#D4DCE8"   # gray line
GM  = "#8899AA"   # gray mid
GD  = "#556677"   # gray dark
AU  = "#C8963E"   # warm accent (for special emphasis)

M = 148  # primary margin
CW = W - 2*M  # content width

# ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
def T(dr, xy, txt, font, color):
    dr.text(xy, txt, font=font, fill=color)

def TR(dr, x, y, txt, font, color):
    b = dr.textbbox((0, 0), txt, font=font)
    dr.text((x - (b[2]-b[0]), y), txt, font=font, fill=color)

def TC(dr, cx, y, txt, font, color):
    b = dr.textbbox((0, 0), txt, font=font)
    dr.text((cx - (b[2]-b[0])/2, y), txt, font=font, fill=color)

def tw(txt, font):
    b = draw.textbbox((0, 0), txt, font=font)
    return b[2] - b[0]

def th(txt, font):
    b = draw.textbbox((0, 0), txt, font=font)
    return b[3] - b[1]

def tbase(txt, font):
    """y-offset to baseline from anchor point"""
    return draw.textbbox((0, 0), txt, font=font)[3]

def BOX(dr, xy, fill=None, outline=None, w=1):
    dr.rectangle(xy, fill=fill, outline=outline, width=w)

def RULE(dr, x1, y1, x2, y2, color, w=1):
    dr.line([(x1, y1), (x2, y2)], fill=color, width=w)

def DOT(dr, cx, cy, r, fill=None):
    dr.ellipse([(cx-r, cy-r), (cx+r, cy+r)], fill=fill)

def ARC(dr, bbox, s, e, color, w=1):
    dr.arc(bbox, start=s, end=e, fill=color, width=w)

# ── Font library ──────────────────────────────────────────────
# Weights: monumental → transitional → annotation
H440  = lambda: ff("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 440)    # hero number
H150  = lambda: ff("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 150)    # BILLION label
H130  = lambda: ff("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 130)    # 68%
H110  = lambda: ff("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 110)    # country big nums
H90   = lambda: ff("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 90)     # 2 BILLION
H60   = lambda: ff("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 60)     # MINUTES
H48   = lambda: ff("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 48)     # small labels
T28   = lambda: ff("Outfit-Bold.ttf", 28)           # section headers
T24   = lambda: ff("Outfit-Bold.ttf", 24)           # footer header
T30   = lambda: ff("Outfit-Bold.ttf", 30)           # main title
B22   = lambda: ff("WorkSans-Regular.ttf", 22)      # body large
B20   = lambda: ff("WorkSans-Regular.ttf", 20)      # body
B18   = lambda: ff("WorkSans-Regular.ttf", 18)      # body small
B16   = lambda: ff("WorkSans-Regular.ttf", 16)      # caption
M15   = lambda: ff("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 15) # mono table
M14   = lambda: ff("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 14) # mono small
M13   = lambda: ff("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 13) # mono tiny
M11   = lambda: ff("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 11) # micro
I18   = lambda: ff("CrimsonPro-Italic.ttf", 18)     # italic accent
I19   = lambda: ff("CrimsonPro-Italic.ttf", 19)     # italic accent l


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# BACKGROUND MOTIFS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# Upper-right globe fragment
gx, gy = W - 170, 660
for rad, asp, s, e in [(360, 0.80, 195, 348), (440, 0.80, 198, 345),
                         (520, 0.80, 202, 342), (400, 0.22, 153, 387),
                         (480, 0.20, 158, 382)]:
    ARC(draw, (gx - rad, gy - rad*asp, gx + rad, gy + rad*asp), s, e, GL, 1)

nodes = [(gx+65,gy-235),(gx+185,gy-148),(gx+250,gy-12),(gx+200,gy+110),
         (gx+95,gy+195),(gx-30,gy+235),(gx-150,gy+185),(gx-225,gy+75),
         (gx-220,gy-55),(gx-130,gy-210),(gx-15,gy-265)]
for x, y in nodes:
    DOT(draw, x, y, 3, fill=GL)
for a, b in [(0,1),(1,2),(2,3),(4,5),(5,6),(6,7),(8,9),(9,10),(3,4),(0,10)]:
    RULE(draw, nodes[a][0], nodes[a][1], nodes[b][0], nodes[b][1], GL, 1)

# Bottom-left globe fragment
gx2, gy2 = 70, H - 350
for rad, s, e in [(130, 28, 172), (190, 28, 172), (250, 28, 172)]:
    ARC(draw, (gx2 - rad, gy2 - rad*0.66, gx2 + rad, gy2 + rad*0.66), s, e, GL, 1)
# Bottom-right subtle network dots
for dx, dy in [(W-280,H-200),(W-220,H-160),(W-320,H-140),(W-250,H-100),(W-350,H-180)]:
    DOT(draw, dx, dy, 2, fill=GL)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# LAYOUT: Fixed vertical positions calculated from verified metrics
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# --- TOP RULE ---
RULE(draw, M, 96, W - M, 96, NV, 2)

# --- HEADER ---
T(draw, (M, 124), "GLOBAL INTERNET USAGE", T30(), NV)
T(draw, (M, 164), "A Cross-Country Comparison", B22(), GD)
T(draw, (M + 504, 164), "·  2025 Data Report", B18(), GM)
TR(draw, W - M, 130, "MAY 2026", M13(), GM)
RULE(draw, M, 200, W - M, 200, NV, 1)

# --- HERO ---
# "5.56" at (M+40, 244): baseline at 244 + 439 = 683
hero_y = 244
T(draw, (M + 40, hero_y), "5.56", H440(), NV)
hero_baseline = hero_y + tbase("5.56", H440())  # 244 + 439 = 683
hero_r = M + 40 + tw("5.56", H440())  # right edge of number

# Vertical accent bar alongside hero number
BOX(draw, (M - 12, hero_y + 78, M, hero_baseline + 6), fill=EL)

# "BILLION" — baseline-aligned with hero
bill_y = hero_baseline - tbase("BILLION", H150())  # 683 - 150 = 533
T(draw, (hero_r + 36, bill_y), "BILLION", H150(), TL)

# Supporting line
sup_y = hero_baseline + 28
T(draw, (M + 40, sup_y), "global internet users worldwide, representing", B22(), ST)

# "68%" stat
p68_y = sup_y + 40
T(draw, (M + 40, p68_y), "68%", H130(), NV)
p68_r = M + 40 + tw("68%", H130())
T(draw, (p68_r + 18, p68_y + 24), "of the world's population", B22(), ST)
T(draw, (p68_r + 18, p68_y + 54), "— roughly 1 in every 1.5 people on Earth", I18(), GM)

# --- CHINA + INDIA CALL-OUT PANELS ---
pnl_w = (CW - 48) // 2
pnl_h = 200
pnl_y = p68_y + 108 + 30  # leave breathing room after 68% section

# China panel
BOX(draw, (M, pnl_y, M + pnl_w, pnl_y + pnl_h), fill=WT, outline=GL, w=1)
BOX(draw, (M, pnl_y, M + pnl_w, pnl_y + 6), fill=EL)
T(draw, (M + 32, pnl_y + 24), "CHINA", T28(), NV)
cn_y = pnl_y + 56
T(draw, (M + 32, cn_y), "~1.09", H110(), NV)
cn_r = M + 32 + tw("~1.09", H110())
T(draw, (cn_r + 14, cn_y + 20), "BILLION", H48(), TL)
T(draw, (M + 32, pnl_y + 160), "ONLINE POPULATION  ·  76% PENETRATION", M14(), GD)

# India panel
ix = M + pnl_w + 48
BOX(draw, (ix, pnl_y, ix + pnl_w, pnl_y + pnl_h), fill=WT, outline=GL, w=1)
BOX(draw, (ix, pnl_y, ix + pnl_w, pnl_y + 6), fill=TL)
T(draw, (ix + 32, pnl_y + 24), "INDIA", T28(), NV)
in_y = pnl_y + 56
T(draw, (ix + 32, in_y), "~900", H110(), NV)
in_r = ix + 32 + tw("~900", H110())
T(draw, (in_r + 14, in_y + 20), "MILLION", H48(), TL)
T(draw, (ix + 32, pnl_y + 160), "ONLINE POPULATION  ·  62% PENETRATION", M14(), GD)

# Combined statement
comb_y = pnl_y + pnl_h + 36
T(draw, (M, comb_y), "Together: nearly", B20(), ST)
cmb = "2 BILLION"
cmb_w = tw(cmb, H90())
T(draw, (M + 188, comb_y - 8), cmb, H90(), TL)
T(draw, (M + 192 + cmb_w, comb_y + 8), "online users — over one-third of the global digital population", B20(), ST)

# --- SECTION: PENETRATION RATES (THE ANALYTICAL CENTERPIECE) ---
sec1_y = comb_y + 78
RULE(draw, M, sec1_y, W - M, sec1_y, GL, 1)

pen_title_y = sec1_y + 44
T(draw, (M, pen_title_y), "INTERNET PENETRATION RATES BY COUNTRY", T28(), NV)
T(draw, (M, pen_title_y + 34), "Percentage of population with internet access  ·  2025 estimates  ·  Ranked by penetration rate", B16(), GD)
RULE(draw, M, pen_title_y + 58, M + 520, pen_title_y + 58, EL, 2)

pen_data = [
    ("South Korea",    98, "  ~50M"),
    ("United Kingdom", 97, "  ~66M"),
    ("Germany",        96, "  ~80M"),
    ("United States",  95, " ~320M"),
    ("Japan",          95, " ~118M"),
    ("Brazil",         88, " ~190M"),
    ("Indonesia",      78, " ~220M"),
    ("China",          76, "~1.09B"),
    ("India",          62, " ~900M"),
    ("Nigeria",        52, " ~115M"),
]

bx = M + 280       # bar start x
br = W - M - 180   # bar end x
bw = br - bx       # bar width
bh = 30            # bar height
bgap = 16          # bar gap
chart_top = pen_title_y + 88
n = len(pen_data)

# 68% global avg reference column
avg_x = bx + int(bw * 0.68)
ref_y0 = chart_top - 18
ref_y1 = chart_top + n * (bh + bgap) + 14
RULE(draw, avg_x, ref_y0, avg_x, ref_y1, GM, 1)
TC(draw, avg_x, ref_y0 - 22, "68% GLOBAL AVG.", M11(), GM)
DOT(draw, avg_x, ref_y0, 4, fill=GM)

for i, (country, pct, pop) in enumerate(pen_data):
    ry = chart_top + i * (bh + bgap)
    # Country label
    TR(draw, bx - 20, ry + 1, country, B18(), NV)
    # Track
    BOX(draw, (bx, ry, br, ry + bh), fill=BG, outline=GL, w=1)
    # Fill
    fw = int(bw * pct / 100)
    if pct >= 95:
        clr = EL
    elif pct >= 80:
        clr = CY
    elif pct >= 70:
        clr = TL
    else:
        clr = NV
    BOX(draw, (bx, ry, bx + fw, ry + bh), fill=clr)
    # % label
    pstr = f"{pct}%"
    T(draw, (bx + fw + 12, ry + 1), pstr, B18(), clr)
    # Population
    T(draw, (br + 16, ry), pop, M14(), GD)

# --- SECTION: SOCIAL MEDIA & DAILY USAGE ---
sec2_y = ref_y1 + 56
RULE(draw, M, sec2_y, W - M, sec2_y, GL, 1)

sm_title_y = sec2_y + 44
T(draw, (M, sm_title_y), "HOW PEOPLE SPEND TIME ONLINE", T28(), NV)
RULE(draw, M, sm_title_y + 38, M + 440, sm_title_y + 38, TL, 2)

# Left column: Big stat
sm_data_y = sm_title_y + 74
T(draw, (M, sm_data_y), "143", H160 := ff("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 160), TL)
r143_w = tw("143", H160)
r143_base = tbase("143", H160)
T(draw, (M + r143_w + 16, sm_data_y + r143_base - tbase("MINUTES", H60()) - 4), "MINUTES", H60(), TL)
T(draw, (M, sm_data_y + r143_base + 12), "Average daily time spent on social media globally in 2025", B19 := ff("WorkSans-Regular.ttf", 19), GD)
T(draw, (M, sm_data_y + r143_base + 40), "Continuing a steady upward trend since 2012", I18(), GM)

# Right column: Platform rankings table
plat = [
    ("Facebook",  "~3.1 billion"),
    ("YouTube",   "~2.5 billion"),
    ("WhatsApp",  "~2.4 billion"),
    ("Instagram", "~2.0 billion"),
    ("TikTok",    "~1.6 billion"),
]
tbl_w = 610
tbl_x = W - M - tbl_w
tbl_y = sm_data_y - 18
tbl_rh = 52  # row height

BOX(draw, (tbl_x, tbl_y, tbl_x + tbl_w, tbl_y + 46), fill=NV)
T(draw, (tbl_x + 24, tbl_y + 12), "PLATFORM", M15(), WT)
TR(draw, tbl_x + tbl_w - 24, tbl_y + 12, "MONTHLY ACTIVE USERS", M15(), WT)

for i, (name, mau) in enumerate(plat):
    ry = tbl_y + 46 + i * tbl_rh
    bg = BG if i % 2 == 0 else WT
    BOX(draw, (tbl_x, ry, tbl_x + tbl_w, ry + tbl_rh), fill=bg)
    T(draw, (tbl_x + 24, ry + 12), name, B22(), NV)
    TR(draw, tbl_x + tbl_w - 24, ry + 12, mau, ff("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 17), GD)
    RULE(draw, tbl_x, ry + tbl_rh, tbl_x + tbl_w, ry + tbl_rh, GL, 1)


# --- SECTION: DIGITAL ECONOMY ---
sec3_y = tbl_y + 46 + len(plat) * tbl_rh + 80
RULE(draw, M, sec3_y, W - M, sec3_y, GL, 1)

econ_title_y = sec3_y + 44
T(draw, (M, econ_title_y), "THE DIGITAL ECONOMY IMPACT", T28(), NV)
T(draw, (M, econ_title_y + 36), "Internet connectivity drives global economic growth across e-commerce, AI, and mobile data", B16(), GD)
RULE(draw, M, econ_title_y + 60, M + 440, econ_title_y + 60, EL, 2)

# Three cards
cw_ = (CW - 64) // 3
ch_ = 275
cards_y = econ_title_y + 98

card_data = [
    ("Global E-Commerce", "$8.0T",
     "projected retail e-commerce\nsales by 2027",
     "Up from $6.3 trillion in 2024",
     ">20% of total retail sales", EL),
    ("AI Market Growth", "$800B+",
     "forecast market size\nby 2030",
     "Up from ~$240 billion in 2023",
     "3.3× growth in 7 years", TL),
    ("Mobile & Data", ">60%",
     "of all web traffic\nis now mobile",
     "180+ zettabytes of data",
     "created globally by 2025", EL),
]

for idx, (title, big_val, desc, sub, tag, accent_c) in enumerate(card_data):
    cx = M + idx * (cw_ + 32)
    BOX(draw, (cx, cards_y, cx + cw_, cards_y + ch_), fill=WT, outline=GL, w=1)
    BOX(draw, (cx, cards_y, cx + cw_, cards_y + 6), fill=accent_c)
    T(draw, (cx + 28, cards_y + 22), title, B20(), NV)
    T(draw, (cx + 28, cards_y + 68), big_val, H96 := ff("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 96), NV)
    for j, dline in enumerate(desc.split("\n")):
        T(draw, (cx + 28, cards_y + 158 + j * 24), dline, B18(), GD)
    T(draw, (cx + 28, cards_y + 220), sub, I19(), GM)
    T(draw, (cx + 28, cards_y + 250), tag, M13(), accent_c)


# --- FOOTER: KEY TAKEAWAYS ---
foot_y = cards_y + ch_ + 64
RULE(draw, M, foot_y, W - M, foot_y, GL, 1)

tk_y = foot_y + 38
T(draw, (M, tk_y), "KEY TAKEAWAYS", T24(), NV)

tk_data = [
    ("Asia dominates absolute online population; Northern Europe and East Asia lead in penetration rates.", EL),
    ("Social media engagement grows steadily — average daily usage now approaching 2.5 hours globally.", CY),
    ("Digital economy expanding rapidly with e-commerce and AI as the primary growth engines.", TL),
    ("Connectivity gaps remain in Sub-Saharan Africa and South Asia — challenges that also represent opportunity.", NV),
]

for i, (txt, clr) in enumerate(tk_data):
    ty = tk_y + 42 + i * 40
    DOT(draw, M + 9, ty + 11, 5, fill=clr)
    T(draw, (M + 30, ty), txt, B18(), ST)

# Bottom rule and attribution
y_end = tk_y + 48 + len(tk_data) * 40 + 48
RULE(draw, M, y_end, W - M, y_end, NV, 2)
T(draw, (M, y_end + 20), "Sources: ITU  ·  World Bank  ·  DataReportal  ·  eMarketer  ·  Statista  —  2025 Estimates", M11(), GM)
TR(draw, W - M, y_end + 20, "SPATIAL METRICS PHILOSOPHY  ·  MUSEUM EDITION", ff("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 10), GL)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SAVE
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
os.makedirs("/app/output", exist_ok=True)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Global Internet Usage Poster — Spatial Metrics philosophy.
A1 portrait, museum-grade execution.
3508 x 4967 px (A1 at 150 DPI)
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import os, math

# ── Canvas ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
W, H = 3508, 4967
canvas = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), "#F7F9FB")
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)

# ── Font engine ───────────────────────────────────────────────
FD = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"
_cache = {}
def ff(name, size):
    k = (name, size)
    if k not in _cache:
        _cache[k] = ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FD, name), size)
    return _cache[k]

# ── Palette ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
NV  = "#091424"   # deep navy (anchoring tone)
ST  = "#1E3048"   # steel
TL  = "#0D7377"   # teal (bridge tone)
CY  = "#00ACC1"   # cyan
EL  = "#0077BE"   # electric blue (accent)
BG  = "#F7F9FB"   # near-white background
WT  = "#FFFFFF"
GL  = "#D4DCE8"   # gray line
GM  = "#8899AA"   # gray mid
GD  = "#556677"   # gray dark
AU  = "#C8963E"   # warm accent (for special emphasis)

M = 148  # primary margin
CW = W - 2*M  # content width

# ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
def T(dr, xy, txt, font, color):
    dr.text(xy, txt, font=font, fill=color)

def TR(dr, x, y, txt, font, color):
    b = dr.textbbox((0, 0), txt, font=font)
    dr.text((x - (b[2]-b[0]), y), txt, font=font, fill=color)

def TC(dr, cx, y, txt, font, color):
    b = dr.textbbox((0, 0), txt, font=font)
    dr.text((cx - (b[2]-b[0])/2, y), txt, font=font, fill=color)

def tw(txt, font):
    b = draw.textbbox((0, 0), txt, font=font)
    return b[2] - b[0]

def th(txt, font):
    b = draw.textbbox((0, 0), txt, font=font)
    return b[3] - b[1]

def tbase(txt, font):
    """y-offset to baseline from anchor point"""
    return draw.textbbox((0, 0), txt, font=font)[3]

def BOX(dr, xy, fill=None, outline=None, w=1):
    dr.rectangle(xy, fill=fill, outline=outline, width=w)

def RULE(dr, x1, y1, x2, y2, color, w=1):
    dr.line([(x1, y1), (x2, y2)], fill=color, width=w)

def DOT(dr, cx, cy, r, fill=None):
    dr.ellipse([(cx-r, cy-r), (cx+r, cy+r)], fill=fill)

def ARC(dr, bbox, s, e, color, w=1):
    dr.arc(bbox, start=s, end=e, fill=color, width=w)

# ── Font library ──────────────────────────────────────────────
# Weights: monumental → transitional → annotation
H440  = lambda: ff("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 440)    # hero number
H150  = lambda: ff("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 150)    # BILLION label
H130  = lambda: ff("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 130)    # 68%
H110  = lambda: ff("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 110)    # country big nums
H90   = lambda: ff("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 90)     # 2 BILLION
H60   = lambda: ff("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 60)     # MINUTES
H48   = lambda: ff("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 48)     # small labels
T28   = lambda: ff("Outfit-Bold.ttf", 28)           # section headers
T24   = lambda: ff("Outfit-Bold.ttf", 24)           # footer header
T30   = lambda: ff("Outfit-Bold.ttf", 30)           # main title
B22   = lambda: ff("WorkSans-Regular.ttf", 22)      # body large
B20   = lambda: ff("WorkSans-Regular.ttf", 20)      # body
B18   = lambda: ff("WorkSans-Regular.ttf", 18)      # body small
B16   = lambda: ff("WorkSans-Regular.ttf", 16)      # caption
M15   = lambda: ff("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 15) # mono table
M14   = lambda: ff("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 14) # mono small
M13   = lambda: ff("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 13) # mono tiny
M11   = lambda: ff("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 11) # micro
I18   = lambda: ff("CrimsonPro-Italic.ttf", 18)     # italic accent
I19   = lambda: ff("CrimsonPro-Italic.ttf", 19)     # italic accent l


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# BACKGROUND MOTIFS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# Upper-right globe fragment
gx, gy = W - 170, 660
for rad, asp, s, e in [(360, 0.80, 195, 348), (440, 0.80, 198, 345),
                         (520, 0.80, 202, 342), (400, 0.22, 153, 387),
                         (480, 0.20, 158, 382)]:
    ARC(draw, (gx - rad, gy - rad*asp, gx + rad, gy + rad*asp), s, e, GL, 1)

nodes = [(gx+65,gy-235),(gx+185,gy-148),(gx+250,gy-12),(gx+200,gy+110),
         (gx+95,gy+195),(gx-30,gy+235),(gx-150,gy+185),(gx-225,gy+75),
         (gx-220,gy-55),(gx-130,gy-210),(gx-15,gy-265)]
for x, y in nodes:
    DOT(draw, x, y, 3, fill=GL)
for a, b in [(0,1),(1,2),(2,3),(4,5),(5,6),(6,7),(8,9),(9,10),(3,4),(0,10)]:
    RULE(draw, nodes[a][0], nodes[a][1], nodes[b][0], nodes[b][1], GL, 1)

# Bottom-left globe fragment
gx2, gy2 = 70, H - 350
for rad, s, e in [(130, 28, 172), (190, 28, 172), (250, 28, 172)]:
    ARC(draw, (gx2 - rad, gy2 - rad*0.66, gx2 + rad, gy2 + rad*0.66), s, e, GL, 1)
# Bottom-right subtle network dots
for dx, dy in [(W-280,H-200),(W-220,H-160),(W-320,H-140),(W-250,H-100),(W-350,H-180)]:
    DOT(draw, dx, dy, 2, fill=GL)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# LAYOUT: Fixed vertical positions calculated from verified metrics
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# --- TOP RULE ---
RULE(draw, M, 96, W - M, 96, NV, 2)

# --- HEADER ---
T(draw, (M, 124), "GLOBAL INTERNET USAGE", T30(), NV)
T(draw, (M, 164), "A Cross-Country Comparison", B22(), GD)
T(draw, (M + 504, 164), "·  2025 Data Report", B18(), GM)
TR(draw, W - M, 130, "MAY 2026", M13(), GM)
RULE(draw, M, 200, W - M, 200, NV, 1)

# --- HERO ---
# "5.56" at (M+40, 244): baseline at 244 + 439 = 683
hero_y = 244
T(draw, (M + 40, hero_y), "5.56", H440(), NV)
hero_baseline = hero_y + tbase("5.56", H440())  # 244 + 439 = 683
hero_r = M + 40 + tw("5.56", H440())  # right edge of number

# Vertical accent bar alongside hero number
BOX(draw, (M - 12, hero_y + 78, M, hero_baseline + 6), fill=EL)

# "BILLION" — baseline-aligned with hero
bill_y = hero_baseline - tbase("BILLION", H150())  # 683 - 150 = 533
T(draw, (hero_r + 36, bill_y), "BILLION", H150(), TL)

# Supporting line
sup_y = hero_baseline + 28
T(draw, (M + 40, sup_y), "global internet users worldwide, representing", B22(), ST)

# "68%" stat
p68_y = sup_y + 40
T(draw, (M + 40, p68_y), "68%", H130(), NV)
p68_r = M + 40 + tw("68%", H130())
T(draw, (p68_r + 18, p68_y + 24), "of the world's population", B22(), ST)
T(draw, (p68_r + 18, p68_y + 54), "— roughly 1 in every 1.5 people on Earth", I18(), GM)

# --- CHINA + INDIA CALL-OUT PANELS ---
pnl_w = (CW - 48) // 2
pnl_h = 200
pnl_y = p68_y + 108 + 30  # leave breathing room after 68% section

# China panel
BOX(draw, (M, pnl_y, M + pnl_w, pnl_y + pnl_h), fill=WT, outline=GL, w=1)
BOX(draw, (M, pnl_y, M + pnl_w, pnl_y + 6), fill=EL)
T(draw, (M + 32, pnl_y + 24), "CHINA", T28(), NV)
cn_y = pnl_y + 56
T(draw, (M + 32, cn_y), "~1.09", H110(), NV)
cn_r = M + 32 + tw("~1.09", H110())
T(draw, (cn_r + 14, cn_y + 20), "BILLION", H48(), TL)
T(draw, (M + 32, pnl_y + 160), "ONLINE POPULATION  ·  76% PENETRATION", M14(), GD)

# India panel
ix = M + pnl_w + 48
BOX(draw, (ix, pnl_y, ix + pnl_w, pnl_y + pnl_h), fill=WT, outline=GL, w=1)
BOX(draw, (ix, pnl_y, ix + pnl_w, pnl_y + 6), fill=TL)
T(draw, (ix + 32, pnl_y + 24), "INDIA", T28(), NV)
in_y = pnl_y + 56
T(draw, (ix + 32, in_y), "~900", H110(), NV)
in_r = ix + 32 + tw("~900", H110())
T(draw, (in_r + 14, in_y + 20), "MILLION", H48(), TL)
T(draw, (ix + 32, pnl_y + 160), "ONLINE POPULATION  ·  62% PENETRATION", M14(), GD)

# Combined statement
comb_y = pnl_y + pnl_h + 36
T(draw, (M, comb_y), "Together: nearly", B20(), ST)
cmb = "2 BILLION"
cmb_w = tw(cmb, H90())
T(draw, (M + 188, comb_y - 8), cmb, H90(), TL)
T(draw, (M + 192 + cmb_w, comb_y + 8), "online users — over one-third of the global digital population", B20(), ST)

# --- SECTION: PENETRATION RATES (THE ANALYTICAL CENTERPIECE) ---
sec1_y = comb_y + 78
RULE(draw, M, sec1_y, W - M, sec1_y, GL, 1)

pen_title_y = sec1_y + 44
T(draw, (M, pen_title_y), "INTERNET PENETRATION RATES BY COUNTRY", T28(), NV)
T(draw, (M, pen_title_y + 34), "Percentage of population with internet access  ·  2025 estimates  ·  Ranked by penetration rate", B16(), GD)
RULE(draw, M, pen_title_y + 58, M + 520, pen_title_y + 58, EL, 2)

pen_data = [
    ("South Korea",    98, "  ~50M"),
    ("United Kingdom", 97, "  ~66M"),
    ("Germany",        96, "  ~80M"),
    ("United States",  95, " ~320M"),
    ("Japan",          95, " ~118M"),
    ("Brazil",         88, " ~190M"),
    ("Indonesia",      78, " ~220M"),
    ("China",          76, "~1.09B"),
    ("India",          62, " ~900M"),
    ("Nigeria",        52, " ~115M"),
]

bx = M + 280       # bar start x
br = W - M - 180   # bar end x
bw = br - bx       # bar width
bh = 30            # bar height
bgap = 16          # bar gap
chart_top = pen_title_y + 88
n = len(pen_data)

# 68% global avg reference column
avg_x = bx + int(bw * 0.68)
ref_y0 = chart_top - 18
ref_y1 = chart_top + n * (bh + bgap) + 14
RULE(draw, avg_x, ref_y0, avg_x, ref_y1, GM, 1)
TC(draw, avg_x, ref_y0 - 22, "68% GLOBAL AVG.", M11(), GM)
DOT(draw, avg_x, ref_y0, 4, fill=GM)

for i, (country, pct, pop) in enumerate(pen_data):
    ry = chart_top + i * (bh + bgap)
    # Country label
    TR(draw, bx - 20, ry + 1, country, B18(), NV)
    # Track
    BOX(draw, (bx, ry, br, ry + bh), fill=BG, outline=GL, w=1)
    # Fill
    fw = int(bw * pct / 100)
    if pct >= 95:
        clr = EL
    elif pct >= 80:
        clr = CY

T(draw, (M, sm_data_y + r143_base + 40), "Continuing a steady upward trend since 2012", I18(), GM)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Global Internet Usage Poster — Spatial Metrics philosophy.
A1 portrait, museum-grade execution.
3508 x 4967 px (A1 at 150 DPI)
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import os, math

# ── Canvas ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
W, H = 3508, 4967
canvas = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), "#F7F9FB")
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)

# ── Font engine ───────────────────────────────────────────────
FD = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"
_cache = {}
def ff(name, size):
    k = (name, size)
    if k not in _cache:
        _cache[k] = ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FD, name), size)
    return _cache[k]

# ── Palette ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
NV  = "#091424"   # deep navy (anchoring tone)
ST  = "#1E3048"   # steel
TL  = "#0D7377"   # teal (bridge tone)
CY  = "#00ACC1"   # cyan
EL  = "#0077BE"   # electric blue (accent)
BG  = "#F7F9FB"   # near-white background
WT  = "#FFFFFF"
GL  = "#D4DCE8"   # gray line
GM  = "#8899AA"   # gray mid
GD  = "#556677"   # gray dark
AU  = "#C8963E"   # warm accent (for special emphasis)

M = 148  # primary margin
CW = W - 2*M  # content width

# ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
def T(dr, xy, txt, font, color):
    dr.text(xy, txt, font=font, fill=color)

def TR(dr, x, y, txt, font, color):
    b = dr.textbbox((0, 0), txt, font=font)
    dr.text((x - (b[2]-b[0]), y), txt, font=font, fill=color)

def TC(dr, cx, y, txt, font, color):
    b = dr.textbbox((0, 0), txt, font=font)
    dr.text((cx - (b[2]-b[0])/2, y), txt, font=font, fill=color)

def tw(txt, font):
    b = draw.textbbox((0, 0), txt, font=font)
    return b[2] - b[0]

def th(txt, font):
    b = draw.textbbox((0, 0), txt, font=font)
    return b[3] - b[1]

def tbase(txt, font):
    """y-offset to baseline from anchor point"""
    return draw.textbbox((0, 0), txt, font=font)[3]

def BOX(dr, xy, fill=None, outline=None, w=1):
    dr.rectangle(xy, fill=fill, outline=outline, width=w)

def RULE(dr, x1, y1, x2, y2, color, w=1):
    dr.line([(x1, y1), (x2, y2)], fill=color, width=w)

def DOT(dr, cx, cy, r, fill=None):
    dr.ellipse([(cx-r, cy-r), (cx+r, cy+r)], fill=fill)

def ARC(dr, bbox, s, e, color, w=1):
    dr.arc(bbox, start=s, end=e, fill=color, width=w)

# ── Font library ──────────────────────────────────────────────
# Weights: monumental → transitional → annotation
H440  = lambda: ff("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 440)    # hero number
H150  = lambda: ff("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 150)    # BILLION label
H130  = lambda: ff("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 130)    # 68%
H110  = lambda: ff("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 110)    # country big nums
H90   = lambda: ff("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 90)     # 2 BILLION
H60   = lambda: ff("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 60)     # MINUTES
H48   = lambda: ff("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 48)     # small labels
T28   = lambda: ff("Outfit-Bold.ttf", 28)           # section headers
T24   = lambda: ff("Outfit-Bold.ttf", 24)           # footer header
T30   = lambda: ff("Outfit-Bold.ttf", 30)           # main title
B22   = lambda: ff("WorkSans-Regular.ttf", 22)      # body large
B20   = lambda: ff("WorkSans-Regular.ttf", 20)      # body
B18   = lambda: ff("WorkSans-Regular.ttf", 18)      # body small
B16   = lambda: ff("WorkSans-Regular.ttf", 16)      # caption
M15   = lambda: ff("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 15) # mono table
M14   = lambda: ff("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 14) # mono small
M13   = lambda: ff("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 13) # mono tiny
M11   = lambda: ff("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 11) # micro
I18   = lambda: ff("CrimsonPro-Italic.ttf", 18)     # italic accent
I19   = lambda: ff("CrimsonPro-Italic.ttf", 19)     # italic accent l


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# BACKGROUND MOTIFS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# Upper-right globe fragment
gx, gy = W - 170, 660
for rad, asp, s, e in [(360, 0.80, 195, 348), (440, 0.80, 198, 345),
                         (520, 0.80, 202, 342), (400, 0.22, 153, 387),
                         (480, 0.20, 158, 382)]:
    ARC(draw, (gx - rad, gy - rad*asp, gx + rad, gy + rad*asp), s, e, GL, 1)

nodes = [(gx+65,gy-235),(gx+185,gy-148),(gx+250,gy-12),(gx+200,gy+110),
         (gx+95,gy+195),(gx-30,gy+235),(gx-150,gy+185),(gx-225,gy+75),
         (gx-220,gy-55),(gx-130,gy-210),(gx-15,gy-265)]
for x, y in nodes:
    DOT(draw, x, y, 3, fill=GL)
for a, b in [(0,1),(1,2),(2,3),(4,5),(5,6),(6,7),(8,9),(9,10),(3,4),(0,10)]:
    RULE(draw, nodes[a][0], nodes[a][1], nodes[b][0], nodes[b][1], GL, 1)

# Bottom-left globe fragment
gx2, gy2 = 70, H - 350
for rad, s, e in [(130, 28, 172), (190, 28, 172), (250, 28, 172)]:

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Global Internet Usage Poster — Spatial Metrics philosophy.
A1 portrait: 3508 × 4967 px (150 DPI).
Layout calibrated to fill ~93% of vertical space.
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import os

canvas = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), "#F6F8FA")
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)

FD = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"
_fc = {}
def ff(name, size):
    k = (name, size)
    if k not in _fc:
        _fc[k] = ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FD, name), size)
    return _fc[k]

# ── Palette (Spatial Metrics: load-bearing color) ─────────────
NV = "#091424"; ST = "#1E3048"; TL = "#0D7377"; CY = "#00ACC1"
EL = "#0077BE"; BG = "#F6F8FA"; WT = "#FFFFFF"; GL = "#D4DCE8"
GM = "#8899AA"; GD = "#556677"; AU = "#C8963E"

M  = 148;  CW = W - 2*M

# ── Drawing primitives ────────────────────────────────────────
def T(dr, xy, txt, font, color):
    dr.text(xy, txt, font=font, fill=color)
def TR(dr, x, y, txt, font, color):
    b = dr.textbbox((0,0), txt, font=font)
    dr.text((x-(b[2]-b[0]), y), txt, font=font, fill=color)
def TC(dr, cx, y, txt, font, color):
    b = dr.textbbox((0,0), txt, font=font)
    dr.text((cx-(b[2]-b[0])/2, y), txt, font=font, fill=color)
def tw(txt, font):
    b = draw.textbbox((0,0), txt, font=font); return b[2]-b[0]
def tbase(txt, font):
    return draw.textbbox((0,0), txt, font=font)[3]
def BOX(dr, xy, fill=None, outline=None, w=1):
    dr.rectangle(xy, fill=fill, outline=outline, width=w)
def RULE(dr, x1, y1, x2, y2, color, w=1):
    dr.line([(x1,y1),(x2,y2)], fill=color, width=w)
def DOT(dr, cx, cy, r, fill=None):
    dr.ellipse([(cx-r,cy-r),(cx+r,cy+r)], fill=fill)
def ARC(dr, bbox, s, e, color, w=1):
    dr.arc(bbox, start=s, end=e, fill=color, width=w)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Global Internet Usage Poster — Spatial Metrics philosophy.
A1 portrait: 3508 × 4967 px (150 DPI).
Layout calibrated to fill ~93% of vertical space.
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import os

W, H = 3508, 4967
canvas = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), "#F6F8FA")
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)

FD = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"
_fc = {}
def ff(name, size):
    k = (name, size)
    if k not in _fc:
        _fc[k] = ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FD, name), size)
    return _fc[k]

# ── Palette (Spatial Metrics: load-bearing color) ─────────────
NV = "#091424"; ST = "#1E3048"; TL = "#0D7377"; CY = "#00ACC1"
EL = "#0077BE"; BG = "#F6F8FA"; WT = "#FFFFFF"; GL = "#D4DCE8"
GM = "#8899AA"; GD = "#556677"; AU = "#C8963E"

M  = 148;  CW = W - 2*M

# ── Drawing primitives ────────────────────────────────────────
def T(dr, xy, txt, font, color):
    dr.text(xy, txt, font=font, fill=color)
def TR(dr, x, y, txt, font, color):
    b = dr.textbbox((0,0), txt, font=font)
    dr.text((x-(b[2]-b[0]), y), txt, font=font, fill=color)
def TC(dr, cx, y, txt, font, color):
    b = dr.textbbox((0,0), txt, font=font)
    dr.text((cx-(b[2]-b[0])/2, y), txt, font=font, fill=color)
def tw(txt, font):
    b = draw.textbbox((0,0), txt, font=font); return b[2]-b[0]
def tbase(txt, font):
    return draw.textbbox((0,0), txt, font=font)[3]
def BOX(dr, xy, fill=None, outline=None, w=1):
    dr.rectangle(xy, fill=fill, outline=outline, width=w)
def RULE(dr, x1, y1, x2, y2, color, w=1):
    dr.line([(x1,y1),(x2,y2)], fill=color, width=w)
def DOT(dr, cx, cy, r, fill=None):
    dr.ellipse([(cx-r,cy-r),(cx+r,cy+r)], fill=fill)
def ARC(dr, bbox, s, e, color, w=1):
    dr.arc(bbox, start=s, end=e, fill=color, width=w)


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# BACKGROUND MOTIFS — Globe arcs + network nodes
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# Upper-right
gx, gy = W - 180, 680
for r, asp, s, e in [(370,0.78,195,348),(455,0.78,198,345),(540,0.78,202,342),
                       (415,0.20,153,387),(495,0.18,158,382)]:
    ARC(draw, (gx-r, gy-r*asp, gx+r, gy+r*asp), s, e, GL, 1)
nd1 = [(gx+60,gy-245),(gx+190,gy-155),(gx+260,gy-10),(gx+205,gy+118),
       (gx+100,gy+205),(gx-30,gy+245),(gx-155,gy+195),(gx-230,gy+80),
       (gx-225,gy-55),(gx-135,gy-218),(gx-15,gy-275)]
for x,y in nd1: DOT(draw, x, y, 3, fill=GL)
for a,b in [(0,1),(1,2),(2,3),(4,5),(5,6),(6,7),(8,9),(9,10),(3,4),(0,10)]:
    RULE(draw, nd1[a][0], nd1[a][1], nd1[b][0], nd1[b][1], GL, 1)

# Bottom-left
gx2, gy2 = 80, H - 380
for r, s, e in [(140,28,172),(205,28,172),(270,28,172)]:
    ARC(draw, (gx2-r, gy2-r*0.64, gx2+r, gy2+r*0.64), s, e, GL, 1)
nd2 = [(gx2+20,gy2-82),(gx2+75,gy2-48),(gx2+110,gy2+24),
       (gx2+72,gy2+92),(gx2-5,gy2+125),(gx2-82,gy2+92)]
for x,y in nd2: DOT(draw, x, y, 2, fill=GL)
for a,b in [(0,1),(1,2),(2,3),(3,4),(4,5)]:
    RULE(draw, nd2[a][0], nd2[a][1], nd2[b][0], nd2[b][1], GL, 1)

# Additional scattering
for dx,dy in [(W-290,H-230),(W-230,H-180),(W-340,H-160),(W-260,H-110),(W-370,H-200),(W-200,H-250)]:
    DOT(draw, dx, dy, 2, fill=GL)


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# VERTICAL LAYOUT — calibrated to fill 93% of A1
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# --- TOP RULE ---
y = 90
RULE(draw, M, y, W-M, y, NV, 2)

# --- HEADER ---
y = 118
T(draw, (M, y), "GLOBAL INTERNET USAGE", ff("Outfit-Bold.ttf", 32), NV)
T(draw, (M, y+42), "A Cross-Country Comparison", ff("WorkSans-Regular.ttf", 24), GD)
T(draw, (M+530, y+42), "·  2025 Data Report", ff("WorkSans-Regular.ttf", 19), GM)
TR(draw, W-M, y+8, "MAY 2026", ff("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 14), GM)
RULE(draw, M, y+80, W-M, y+80, NV, 1)

# --- HERO SECTION ---
y = 224
# Vertical accent bar
BOX(draw, (M-14, y+80, M, y+80+370), fill=EL)
# "5.56" — monumental
T(draw, (M+44, y), "5.56", ff("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 480), NV)
h_base = y + tbase("5.56", ff("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 480))  # baseline
h_right = M + 44 + tw("5.56", ff("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 480))
# "BILLION" baseline-aligned
bill_f = ff("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 160)
T(draw, (h_right + 40, h_base - tbase("BILLION", bill_f)), "BILLION", bill_f, TL)

# 68% stat
y = h_base + 34
T(draw, (M+44, y), "global internet users worldwide, representing approximately", ff("WorkSans-Regular.ttf", 24), ST)
y += 44
T(draw, (M+44, y), "68%", ff("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 140), NV)
r68 = M + 44 + tw("68%", ff("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 140))
T(draw, (r68+20, y+26), "of the world's population", ff("WorkSans-Regular.ttf", 24), ST)
T(draw, (r68+20, y+58), "— roughly 1 in every 1.5 people on Earth", ff("CrimsonPro-Italic.ttf", 19), GM)

# --- CHINA + INDIA PANELS ---
y += 146
pw = (CW - 56) // 2; ph = 228

# China
BOX(draw, (M, y, M+pw, y+ph), fill=WT, outline=GL, w=1)
BOX(draw, (M, y, M+pw, y+7), fill=EL)
T(draw, (M+36, y+28), "CHINA", ff("Outfit-Bold.ttf", 30), NV)
T(draw, (M+36, y+64), "~1.09", ff("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 120), NV)
r_cn = M + 36 + tw("~1.09", ff("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 120))
T(draw, (r_cn+16, y+84), "BILLION", ff("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 52), TL)
T(draw, (M+36, y+184), "ONLINE POPULATION  ·  76% PENETRATION RATE", ff("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 15), GD)

# India
ix = M + pw + 56
BOX(draw, (ix, y, ix+pw, y+ph), fill=WT, outline=GL, w=1)
BOX(draw, (ix, y, ix+pw, y+7), fill=TL)
T(draw, (ix+36, y+28), "INDIA", ff("Outfit-Bold.ttf", 30), NV)
T(draw, (ix+36, y+64), "~900", ff("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 120), NV)
r_in = ix + 36 + tw("~900", ff("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 120))
T(draw, (r_in+16, y+84), "MILLION", ff("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 52), TL)
T(draw, (ix+36, y+184), "ONLINE POPULATION  ·  62% PENETRATION RATE", ff("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 15), GD)

# Combined statement
y += ph + 44
T(draw, (M, y), "Together: nearly", ff("WorkSans-Regular.ttf", 22), ST)
cb = "2 BILLION"
cbw = tw(cb, ff("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 96))
T(draw, (M+196, y-10), cb, ff("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 96), TL)
T(draw, (M+200+cbw, y+6), "online users — over one-third of the global digital population", ff("WorkSans-Regular.ttf", 22), ST)


# --- PENETRATION RATES (CENTRAL ANALYTICAL FEATURE) ---
y += 110
RULE(draw, M, y, W-M, y, GL, 1)

y += 50
T(draw, (M, y), "INTERNET PENETRATION RATES BY COUNTRY", ff("Outfit-Bold.ttf", 30), NV)
T(draw, (M, y+38), "Percentage of population with internet access  ·  2025 estimates  ·  Ranked by penetration rate", ff("WorkSans-Regular.ttf", 17), GD)
RULE(draw, M, y+64, M+560, y+64, EL, 2)

pen = [
    ("South Korea",    98, "  ~50M"),
    ("United Kingdom", 97, "  ~66M"),
    ("Germany",        96, "  ~80M"),
    ("United States",  95, " ~320M"),
    ("Japan",          95, " ~118M"),
    ("Brazil",         88, " ~190M"),
    ("Indonesia",      78, " ~220M"),
    ("China",          76, "~1.09B"),
    ("India",          62, " ~900M"),
    ("Nigeria",        52, " ~115M"),
]

bx = M + 290; br = W - M - 190; bw_ = br - bx; bh_ = 34; bgap_ = 20
ctop = y + 100; n = len(pen)
avg_x = bx + int(bw_ * 0.68)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Global Internet Usage Poster — Spatial Metrics philosophy.
A1 portrait: 3508 × 4967 px (150 DPI).
Layout calibrated to fill ~93% of vertical space.
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import os

W, H = 3508, 4967
canvas = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), "#F6F8FA")
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)

FD = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"
_fc = {}
def ff(name, size):
    k = (name, size)
    if k not in _fc:
        _fc[k] = ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FD, name), size)
    return _fc[k]

# ── Palette (Spatial Metrics: load-bearing color) ─────────────
NV = "#091424"; ST = "#1E3048"; TL = "#0D7377"; CY = "#00ACC1"
EL = "#0077BE"; BG = "#F6F8FA"; WT = "#FFFFFF"; GL = "#D4DCE8"
GM = "#8899AA"; GD = "#556677"; AU = "#C8963E"

M  = 148;  CW = W - 2*M

# ── Drawing primitives ────────────────────────────────────────
def T(dr, xy, txt, font, color):
    dr.text(xy, txt, font=font, fill=color)
def TR(dr, x, y, txt, font, color):
    b = dr.textbbox((0,0), txt, font=font)
    dr.text((x-(b[2]-b[0]), y), txt, font=font, fill=color)
def TC(dr, cx, y, txt, font, color):
    b = dr.textbbox((0,0), txt, font=font)
    dr.text((cx-(b[2]-b[0])/2, y), txt, font=font, fill=color)
def tw(txt, font):
    b = draw.textbbox((0,0), txt, font=font); return b[2]-b[0]
def tbase(txt, font):
    return draw.textbbox((0,0), txt, font=font)[3]
def BOX(dr, xy, fill=None, outline=None, w=1):
    dr.rectangle(xy, fill=fill, outline=outline, width=w)
def RULE(dr, x1, y1, x2, y2, color, w=1):
    dr.line([(x1,y1),(x2,y2)], fill=color, width=w)
def DOT(dr, cx, cy, r, fill=None):
    dr.ellipse([(cx-r,cy-r),(cx+r,cy+r)], fill=fill)
def ARC(dr, bbox, s, e, color, w=1):
    dr.arc(bbox, start=s, end=e, fill=color, width=w)


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# BACKGROUND MOTIFS — Globe arcs + network nodes
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# Upper-right
gx, gy = W - 180, 680
for r, asp, s, e in [(370,0.78,195,348),(455,0.78,198,345),(540,0.78,202,342),
                       (415,0.20,153,387),(495,0.18,158,382)]:
    ARC(draw, (gx-r, gy-r*asp, gx+r, gy+r*asp), s, e, GL, 1)
nd1 = [(gx+60,gy-245),(gx+190,gy-155),(gx+260,gy-10),(gx+205,gy+118),
       (gx+100,gy+205),(gx-30,gy+245),(gx-155,gy+195),(gx-230,gy+80),
       (gx-225,gy-55),(gx-135,gy-218),(gx-15,gy-275)]
for x,y in nd1: DOT(draw, x, y, 3, fill=GL)
for a,b in [(0,1),(1,2),(2,3),(4,5),(5,6),(6,7),(8,9),(9,10),(3,4),(0,10)]:
    RULE(draw, nd1[a][0], nd1[a][1], nd1[b][0], nd1[b][1], GL, 1)

# Bottom-left
gx2, gy2 = 80, H - 380
for r, s, e in [(140,28,172),(205,28,172),(270,28,172)]:
    ARC(draw, (gx2-r, gy2-r*0.64, gx2+r, gy2+r*0.64), s, e, GL, 1)
nd2 = [(gx2+20,gy2-82),(gx2+75,gy2-48),(gx2+110,gy2+24),
       (gx2+72,gy2+92),(gx2-5,gy2+125),(gx2-82,gy2+92)]
for x,y in nd2: DOT(draw, x, y, 2, fill=GL)
for a,b in [(0,1),(1,2),(2,3),(3,4),(4,5)]:
    RULE(draw, nd2[a][0], nd2[a][1], nd2[b][0], nd2[b][1], GL, 1)

# Additional scattering
for dx,dy in [(W-290,H-230),(W-230,H-180),(W-340,H-160),(W-260,H-110),(W-370,H-200),(W-200,H-250)]:
    DOT(draw, dx, dy, 2, fill=GL)


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# VERTICAL LAYOUT — calibrated to fill 93% of A1
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# --- TOP RULE ---
y = 90
RULE(draw, M, y, W-M, y, NV, 2)

# --- HEADER ---
y = 118
T(draw, (M, y), "GLOBAL INTERNET USAGE", ff("Outfit-Bold.ttf", 32), NV)
T(draw, (M, y+42), "A Cross-Country Comparison", ff("WorkSans-Regular.ttf", 24), GD)
T(draw, (M+530, y+42), "·  2025 Data Report", ff("WorkSans-Regular.ttf", 19), GM)
TR(draw, W-M, y+8, "MAY 2026", ff("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 14), GM)
RULE(draw, M, y+80, W-M, y+80, NV, 1)

# --- HERO SECTION ---
y = 224
# Vertical accent bar
BOX(draw, (M-14, y+80, M, y+80+370), fill=EL)
# "5.56" — monumental
T(draw, (M+44, y), "5.56", ff("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 480), NV)
h_base = y + tbase("5.56", ff("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 480))  # baseline
h_right = M + 44 + tw("5.56", ff("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 480))
# "BILLION" baseline-aligned
bill_f = ff("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 160)
T(draw, (h_right + 40, h_base - tbase("BILLION", bill_f)), "BILLION", bill_f, TL)

# 68% stat
y = h_base + 34
T(draw, (M+44, y), "global internet users worldwide, representing approximately", ff("WorkSans-Regular.ttf", 24), ST)
y += 44
T(draw, (M+44, y), "68%", ff("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 140), NV)
r68 = M + 44 + tw("68%", ff("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 140))
T(draw, (r68+20, y+26), "of the world's population", ff("WorkSans-Regular.ttf", 24), ST)
T(draw, (r68+20, y+58), "— roughly 1 in every 1.5 people on Earth", ff("CrimsonPro-Italic.ttf", 19), GM)

# --- CHINA + INDIA PANELS ---
y += 146
pw = (CW - 56) // 2; ph = 228

# China
BOX(draw, (M, y, M+pw, y+ph), fill=WT, outline=GL, w=1)
BOX(draw, (M, y, M+pw, y+7), fill=EL)
T(draw, (M+36, y+28), "CHINA", ff("Outfit-Bold.ttf", 30), NV)
T(draw, (M+36, y+64), "~1.09", ff("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 120), NV)
r_cn = M + 36 + tw("~1.09", ff("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 120))
T(draw, (r_cn+16, y+84), "BILLION", ff("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 52), TL)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Global Internet Usage Poster — Spatial Metrics philosophy.
A1 portrait: 3508 × 4967 px (150 DPI).
Layout calibrated to fill ~93% of vertical space.
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import os

W, H = 3508, 4967
canvas = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), "#F6F8FA")
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)

FD = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"
_fc = {}
def ff(name, size):
    k = (name, size)
    if k not in _fc:
        _fc[k] = ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FD, name), size)
    return _fc[k]

# ── Palette (Spatial Metrics: load-bearing color) ─────────────
NV = "#091424"; ST = "#1E3048"; TL = "#0D7377"; CY = "#00ACC1"
EL = "#0077BE"; BG = "#F6F8FA"; WT = "#FFFFFF"; GL = "#D4DCE8"
GM = "#8899AA"; GD = "#556677"; AU = "#C8963E"

M  = 148;  CW = W - 2*M

# ── Drawing primitives ────────────────────────────────────────
def T(dr, xy, txt, font, color):
    dr.text(xy, txt, font=font, fill=color)
def TR(dr, x, y, txt, font, color):
    b = dr.textbbox((0,0), txt, font=font)
    dr.text((x-(b[2]-b[0]), y), txt, font=font, fill=color)
def TC(dr, cx, y, txt, font, color):
    b = dr.textbbox((0,0), txt, font=font)
    dr.text((cx-(b[2]-b[0])/2, y), txt, font=font, fill=color)
def tw(txt, font):
    b = draw.textbbox((0,0), txt, font=font); return b[2]-b[0]
def tbase(txt, font):
    return draw.textbbox((0,0), txt, font=font)[3]
def BOX(dr, xy, fill=None, outline=None, w=1):
    dr.rectangle(xy, fill=fill, outline=outline, width=w)
def RULE(dr, x1, y1, x2, y2, color, w=1):
    dr.line([(x1,y1),(x2,y2)], fill=color, width=w)
def DOT(dr, cx, cy, r, fill=None):
    dr.ellipse([(cx-r,cy-r),(cx+r,cy+r)], fill=fill)
def ARC(dr, bbox, s, e, color, w=1):
    dr.arc(bbox, start=s, end=e, fill=color, width=w)


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# BACKGROUND MOTIFS — Globe arcs + network nodes
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# Upper-right
gx, gy = W - 180, 680
for r, asp, s, e in [(370,0.78,195,348),(455,0.78,198,345),(540,0.78,202,342),
                       (415,0.20,153,387),(495,0.18,158,382)]:
    ARC(draw, (gx-r, gy-r*asp, gx+r, gy+r*asp), s, e, GL, 1)
nd1 = [(gx+60,gy-245),(gx+190,gy-155),(gx+260,gy-10),(gx+205,gy+118),
       (gx+100,gy+205),(gx-30,gy+245),(gx-155,gy+195),(gx-230,gy+80),
       (gx-225,gy-55),(gx-135,gy-218),(gx-15,gy-275)]
for x,y in nd1: DOT(draw, x, y, 3, fill=GL)
for a,b in [(0,1),(1,2),(2,3),(4,5),(5,6),(6,7),(8,9),(9,10),(3,4),(0,10)]:
    RULE(draw, nd1[a][0], nd1[a][1], nd1[b][0], nd1[b][1], GL, 1)

# Bottom-left
gx2, gy2 = 80, H - 380
for r, s, e in [(140,28,172),(205,28,172),(270,28,172)]:
    ARC(draw, (gx2-r, gy2-r*0.64, gx2+r, gy2+r*0.64), s, e, GL, 1)
nd2 = [(gx2+20,gy2-82),(gx2+75,gy2-48),(gx2+110,gy2+24),
       (gx2+72,gy2+92),(gx2-5,gy2+125),(gx2-82,gy2+92)]
for x,y in nd2: DOT(draw, x, y, 2, fill=GL)
for a,b in [(0,1),(1,2),(2,3),(3,4),(4,5)]:
    RULE(draw, nd2[a][0], nd2[a][1], nd2[b][0], nd2[b][1], GL, 1)

# Additional scattering
for dx,dy in [(W-290,H-230),(W-230,H-180),(W-340,H-160),(W-260,H-110),(W-370,H-200),(W-200,H-250)]:
    DOT(draw, dx, dy, 2, fill=GL)


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# VERTICAL LAYOUT — calibrated to fill 93% of A1
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Global Internet Usage Poster — Spatial Metrics philosophy.
A1 portrait: 3508 × 4967 px (150 DPI). ~90% vertical fill.
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import os

W, H = 3508, 4967
canvas = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), "#F7F9FB")
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)

FD = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"
_fc = {}
def ff(name, size):
    k = (name, size)
    if k not in _fc:
        _fc[k] = ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FD, name), size)
    return _fc[k]

# ── Palette ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
NV = "#091424"; ST = "#1E3048"; TL = "#0D7377"; CY = "#00ACC1"
EL = "#0077BE"; BG = "#F7F9FB"; WT = "#FFFFFF"; GL = "#D4DCE8"
GM = "#8899AA"; GD = "#556677"

M  = 148; CW = W - 2*M

# ── Primitives ────────────────────────────────────────────────
def T(dr, xy, txt, font, color):
    dr.text(xy, txt, font=font, fill=color)
def TR(dr, x, y, txt, font, color):
    b = dr.textbbox((0,0), txt, font=font)
    dr.text((x-(b[2]-b[0]), y), txt, font=font, fill=color)
def TC(dr, cx, y, txt, font, color):
    b = dr.textbbox((0,0), txt, font=font)
    dr.text((cx-(b[2]-b[0])/2, y), txt, font=font, fill=color)
def tw(txt, font):
    b = draw.textbbox((0,0), txt, font=font); return b[2]-b[0]
def tbase(txt, font):
    return draw.textbbox((0,0), txt, font=font)[3]
def BOX(dr, xy, fill=None, outline=None, w=1):
    dr.rectangle(xy, fill=fill, outline=outline, width=w)
def RULE(dr, x1, y1, x2, y2, color, w=1):
    dr.line([(x1,y1),(x2,y2)], fill=color, width=w)
def DOT(dr, cx, cy, r, fill=None):
    dr.ellipse([(cx-r,cy-r),(cx+r,cy+r)], fill=fill)
def ARC(dr, bbox, s, e, color, w=1):
    dr.arc(bbox, start=s, end=e, fill=color, width=w)

# ── Font reference ────────────────────────────────────────────
# BigShoulders-Bold: hero numerals (condensed, powerful)
# Outfit-Bold: section headers
# WorkSans-Regular: body text
# JetBrainsMono-Regular: data tables, labels
# CrimsonPro-Italic: accent lines, quotations

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# BACKGROUND — Globe & network motifs
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# Upper-right globe fragment
gx, gy = W - 190, 700
for r, asp, s, e in [(380,0.77,194,346),(470,0.77,198,342),(560,0.77,202,339),
                       (430,0.19,152,388),(510,0.17,157,383)]:
    ARC(draw, (gx-r, gy-r*asp, gx+r, gy+r*asp), s, e, GL, 1)
nd = [(gx+62,gy-250),(gx+195,gy-160),(gx+268,gy-10),(gx+210,gy+122),
      (gx+105,gy+212),(gx-30,gy+252),(gx-160,gy+200),(gx-238,gy+82),
      (gx-232,gy-58),(gx-140,gy-225),(gx-18,gy-285)]
for x,y in nd: DOT(draw, x, y, 3, fill=GL)
for a,b in [(0,1),(1,2),(2,3),(4,5),(5,6),(6,7),(8,9),(9,10),(3,4),(0,10),(6,3)]:
    RULE(draw, nd[a][0], nd[a][1], nd[b][0], nd[b][1], GL, 1)

# Bottom-left globe fragment
gx2, gy2 = 90, H - 400
for r, s, e in [(150,26,170),(220,26,170),(290,26,170)]:
    ARC(draw, (gx2-r, gy2-r*0.63, gx2+r, gy2+r*0.63), s, e, GL, 1)
nd2 = [(gx2+22,gy2-88),(gx2+82,gy2-52),(gx2+118,gy2+26),
       (gx2+78,gy2+100),(gx2-8,gy2+135),(gx2-88,gy2+98)]
for x,y in nd2: DOT(draw, x, y, 2, fill=GL)
for a,b in [(0,1),(1,2),(2,3),(3,4),(4,5)]:
    RULE(draw, nd2[a][0], nd2[a][1], nd2[b][0], nd2[b][1], GL, 1)

# Scattered reference dots
for dx,dy in [(W-300,H-250),(W-240,H-195),(W-350,H-175),(W-270,H-120),
              (W-380,H-215),(W-210,H-265),(W-320,H-310)]:

T(draw, (M+534, y+42), "·  2025 Data Report", ff("WorkSans-Regular.ttf", 19), GM)
TR(draw, W-M, y+10, "MAY 2026", ff("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 14), GM)
RULE(draw, M, y+82, W-M, y+82, NV, 1)


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 2. HERO — 5.56 BILLION
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
y = 240
Hf = ff("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 480)
BOX(draw, (M-14, y+82, M, y+82+370), fill=EL)  # vertical accent
T(draw, (M+44, y), "5.56", Hf, NV)
h_base = y + tbase("5.56", Hf)
h_right = M + 44 + tw("5.56", Hf)

Bf = ff("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 160)
T(draw, (h_right + 44, h_base - tbase("BILLION", Bf)), "BILLION", Bf, TL)

# 68% stat
y = h_base + 38
T(draw, (M+44, y), "global internet users worldwide, representing approximately", ff("WorkSans-Regular.ttf", 24), ST)
y += 46
T(draw, (M+44, y), "68%", ff("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 140), NV)
r68 = M + 44 + tw("68%", ff("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 140))
T(draw, (r68+22, y+28), "of the world's population", ff("WorkSans-Regular.ttf", 24), ST)
T(draw, (r68+22, y+60), "— roughly 1 in every 1.5 people on Earth", ff("CrimsonPro-Italic.ttf", 20), GM)


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 3. CHINA + INDIA — Dominant populations
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
y = y + 158
pw = (CW - 60) // 2; ph = 236

# China
BOX(draw, (M, y, M+pw, y+ph), fill=WT, outline=GL, w=1)
BOX(draw, (M, y, M+pw, y+7), fill=EL)
T(draw, (M+38, y+28), "CHINA", ff("Outfit-Bold.ttf", 30), NV)
T(draw, (M+38, y+66), "~1.09", ff("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 124), NV)
r_cn = M + 38 + tw("~1.09", ff("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 124))
T(draw, (r_cn+18, y+88), "BILLION", ff("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 54), TL)
T(draw, (M+38, y+192), "ONLINE POPULATION  ·  76% PENETRATION RATE", ff("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 15), GD)

# India
ix = M + pw + 60
BOX(draw, (ix, y, ix+pw, y+ph), fill=WT, outline=GL, w=1)
BOX(draw, (ix, y, ix+pw, y+7), fill=TL)
T(draw, (ix+38, y+28), "INDIA", ff("Outfit-Bold.ttf", 30), NV)
T(draw, (ix+38, y+66), "~900", ff("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 124), NV)
r_in = ix + 38 + tw("~900", ff("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 124))
T(draw, (r_in+18, y+88), "MILLION", ff("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 54), TL)
T(draw, (ix+38, y+192), "ONLINE POPULATION  ·  62% PENETRATION RATE", ff("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 15), GD)

# Combined
y += ph + 52
T(draw, (M, y), "Together: nearly", ff("WorkSans-Regular.ttf", 22), ST)
cb = "2 BILLION"
cbw = tw(cb, ff("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 100))
T(draw, (M+198, y-12), cb, ff("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 100), TL)
T(draw, (M+202+cbw, y+6), "online users — over one-third of the global digital population", ff("WorkSans-Regular.ttf", 22), ST)


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 4. PENETRATION RATES — Analytical centerpiece
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
y += 172
RULE(draw, M, y, W-M, y, GL, 1)

y += 50
T(draw, (M, y), "INTERNET PENETRATION RATES BY COUNTRY", ff("Outfit-Bold.ttf", 30), NV)
T(draw, (M, y+40), "Percentage of population with internet access  ·  2025 estimates  ·  Ranked by penetration rate", ff("WorkSans-Regular.ttf", 17), GD)
RULE(draw, M, y+66, M+560, y+66, EL, 2)

pen = [
    ("South Korea",    98, "  ~50 million"),
    ("United Kingdom", 97, "  ~66 million"),
    ("Germany",        96, "  ~80 million"),
    ("United States",  95, " ~320 million"),
    ("Japan",          95, " ~118 million"),
    ("Brazil",         88, " ~190 million"),
    ("Indonesia",      78, " ~220 million"),
    ("China",          76, "~1.09 billion"),
    ("India",          62, " ~900 million"),
    ("Nigeria",        52, " ~115 million"),
]

bx = M + 295; br = W - M - 200; bw_ = br - bx
bh_ = 38; bgap_ = 26
ctop = y + 104; n = len(pen)

# Global average reference
avg_x = bx + int(bw_ * 0.68)
RULE(draw, avg_x, ctop-24, avg_x, ctop + n*(bh_+bgap_) + 20, GM, 1)
TC(draw, avg_x, ctop-50, "68% GLOBAL AVG.", ff("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 12), GM)
DOT(draw, avg_x, ctop-24, 5, fill=GM)

for i, (country, pct, pop) in enumerate(pen):

    TR(draw, bx-26, ry+3, country, ff("WorkSans-Regular.ttf", 20), NV)

chart_bottom = ctop + n*(bh_+bgap_)


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

y = chart_bottom + 32 + 172
RULE(draw, M, y, W-M, y, GL, 1)

T(draw, (M, y+40), "Daily social media engagement  ·  Platform dominance  ·  2025 data", ff("WorkSans-Regular.ttf", 17), GD)

r143 = M + tw("143", f170)
f64 = ff("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 68)
T(draw, (r143+20, y_sm + tbase("143", f170) - tbase("MINUTES", f64) - 4), "MINUTES", f64, TL)
T(draw, (M, y_sm + tbase("143", f170) + 16), "Average daily time spent on social media globally in 2025", ff("WorkSans-Regular.ttf", 20), GD)
T(draw, (M, y_sm + tbase("143", f170) + 48), "Continuing a steady upward trend since 2012", ff("CrimsonPro-Italic.ttf", 20), GM)

# Right: Platform table
plat = [
    ("Facebook",  "~3.1 billion"),
    ("YouTube",   "~2.5 billion"),
    ("WhatsApp",  "~2.4 billion"),
    ("Instagram", "~2.0 billion"),
    ("TikTok",    "~1.6 billion"),
]
tw_ = 650; tx_ = W - M - tw_; ty_ = y_sm - 22; trh = 60
BOX(draw, (tx_, ty_, tx_+tw_, ty_+52), fill=NV)
T(draw, (tx_+28, ty_+14), "PLATFORM", ff("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 16), WT)
TR(draw, tx_+tw_-28, ty_+14, "MONTHLY ACTIVE USERS", ff("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 16), WT)
for i,(name,mau) in enumerate(plat):
    ry = ty_+52 + i*trh
    BOX(draw, (tx_, ry, tx_+tw_, ry+trh), fill=BG if i%2==0 else WT)
    T(draw, (tx_+28, ry+14), name, ff("WorkSans-Regular.ttf", 25), NV)
    TR(draw, tx_+tw_-28, ry+15, mau, ff("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 18), GD)
    RULE(draw, tx_, ry+trh, tx_+tw_, ry+trh, GL, 1)

y = ty_ + 52 + len(plat)*trh + 172
RULE(draw, M, y, W-M, y, GL, 1)

y += 50
T(draw, (M, y), "THE DIGITAL ECONOMY IMPACT", ff("Outfit-Bold.ttf", 30), NV)
T(draw, (M, y+40), "Internet connectivity drives global economic growth across e-commerce, AI, and mobile data", ff("WorkSans-Regular.ttf", 17), GD)

cards = [

     "Up from $6.3 trillion in 2024", ">20% of total retail sales", EL),
    ("AI Market Growth", "$800B+", "forecast market size\nby 2030",
     "Up from ~$240 billion in 2023", "3.3× growth in 7 years", TL),
    ("Mobile & Data", ">60%", "of all web traffic\nis now mobile",
     "180+ zettabytes of data", "created globally by 2025", EL),
]
for idx, (title, big, desc, sub, tag, ac) in enumerate(cards):
    cx = M + idx*(cw3+38)
    BOX(draw, (cx, cards_y, cx+cw3, cards_y+ch3), fill=WT, outline=GL, w=1)
    BOX(draw, (cx, cards_y, cx+cw3, cards_y+8), fill=ac)
    T(draw, (cx+34, cards_y+30), title, ff("WorkSans-Regular.ttf", 22), NV)
    T(draw, (cx+34, cards_y+84), big, ff("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 110), NV)
    for j,dline in enumerate(desc.split("\n")):
        T(draw, (cx+34, cards_y+190+j*28), dline, ff("WorkSans-Regular.ttf", 19), GD)
    T(draw, (cx+34, cards_y+268), sub, ff("CrimsonPro-Italic.ttf", 20), GM)
    T(draw, (cx+34, cards_y+304), tag, ff("JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf", 14), ac)


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 7. KEY TAKEAWAYS + FOOTER
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
y = cards_y + ch3 + 172

T(draw, (M, y), "KEY TAKEAWAYS", ff("Outfit-Bold.ttf", 28), NV)

    ("Asia dominates absolute online population; Northern Europe and East Asia lead in penetration rates.", EL),

for i, (txt, clr) in enumerate(tks):

# ── SAVE ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
os.makedirs("/app/output", exist_ok=True)

print(f"OK {W}×{H}px → /app/output/final_poster.png (content bottom ≈ {y+44}px / {H}px = {(y+44)/H*100:.0f}%)")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Global Internet Usage Poster — Spatial Metrics philosophy.
A1 portrait: 3508 × 4967 px (150 DPI). ~90% vertical fill.
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import os

W, H = 3508, 4967
canvas = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), "#F7F9FB")
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)

FD = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"
_fc = {}
def ff(name, size):
    k = (name, size)
    if k not in _fc:
        _fc[k] = ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FD, name), size)
    return _fc[k]

# ── Palette ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
NV = "#091424"; ST = "#1E3048"; TL = "#0D7377"; CY = "#00ACC1"
EL = "#0077BE"; BG = "#F7F9FB"; WT = "#FFFFFF"; GL = "#D4DCE8"
GM = "#8899AA"; GD = "#556677"

M  = 148; CW = W - 2*M

# ── Primitives ────────────────────────────────────────────────
def T(dr, xy, txt, font, color):
    dr.text(xy, txt, font=font, fill=color)
def TR(dr, x, y, txt, font, color):
    b = dr.textbbox((0,0), txt, font=font)
    dr.text((x-(b[2]-b[0]), y), txt, font=font, fill=color)
def TC(dr, cx, y, txt, font, color):
    b = dr.textbbox((0,0), txt, font=font)
    dr.text((cx-(b[2]-b[0])/2, y), txt, font=font, fill=color)
def tw(txt, font):
    b = draw.textbbox((0,0), txt, font=font); return b[2]-b[0]
def tbase(txt, font):
    return draw.textbbox((0,0), txt, font=font)[3]
def BOX(dr, xy, fill=None, outline=None, w=1):
    dr.rectangle(xy, fill=fill, outline=outline, width=w)
def RULE(dr, x1, y1, x2, y2, color, w=1):
    dr.line([(x1,y1),(x2,y2)], fill=color, width=w)
def DOT(dr, cx, cy, r, fill=None):
    dr.ellipse([(cx-r,cy-r),(cx+r,cy+r)], fill=fill)
def ARC(dr, bbox, s, e, color, w=1):
    dr.arc(bbox, start=s, end=e, fill=color, width=w)

# ── Font reference ────────────────────────────────────────────
# BigShoulders-Bold: hero numerals (condensed, powerful)
# Outfit-Bold: section headers
# WorkSans-Regular: body text
# JetBrainsMono-Regular: data tables, labels
# CrimsonPro-Italic: accent lines, quotations

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# BACKGROUND — Globe & network motifs
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# Upper-right globe fragment
gx, gy = W - 190, 700
for r, asp, s, e in [(380,0.77,194,346),(470,0.77,198,342),(560,0.77,202,339),
                       (430,0.19,152,388),(510,0.17,157,383)]:
    ARC(draw, (gx-r, gy-r*asp, gx+r, gy+r*asp), s, e, GL, 1)
nd = [(gx+62,gy-250),(gx+195,gy-160),(gx+268,gy-10),(gx+210,gy+122),
      (gx+105,gy+212),(gx-30,gy+252),(gx-160,gy+200),(gx-238,gy+82),
      (gx-232,gy-58),(gx-140,gy-225),(gx-18,gy-285)]
for x,y in nd: DOT(draw, x, y, 3, fill=GL)
for a,b in [(0,1),(1,2),(2,3),(4,5),(5,6),(6,7),(8,9),(9,10),(3,4),(0,10),(6,3)]:
    RULE(draw, nd[a][0], nd[a][1], nd[b][0], nd[b][1], GL, 1)

# Bottom-left globe fragment
gx2, gy2 = 90, H - 400
for r, s, e in [(150,26,170),(220,26,170),(290,26,170)]:
    ARC(draw, (gx2-r, gy2-r*0.63, gx2+r, gy2+r*0.63), s, e, GL, 1)
nd2 = [(gx2+22,gy2-88),(gx2+82,gy2-52),(gx2+118,gy2+26),
       (gx2+78,gy2+100),(gx2-8,gy2+135),(gx2-88,gy2+98)]
for x,y in nd2: DOT(draw, x, y, 2, fill=GL)
for a,b in [(0,1),(1,2),(2,3),(3,4),(4,5)]:
    RULE(draw, nd2[a][0], nd2[a][1], nd2[b][0], nd2[b][1], GL, 1)

# Scattered reference dots
for dx,dy in [(W-300,H-250),(W-240,H-195),(W-350,H-175),(W-270,H-120),
              (W-380,H-215),(W-210,H-265),(W-320,H-310)]:
    DOT(draw, dx, dy, 2, fill=GL)


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 1. TOP RULE + HEADER
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
y = 90
RULE(draw, M, y, W-M, y, NV, 2)

y = 120
T(draw, (M, y), "GLOBAL INTERNET USAGE", ff("Outfit-Bold.ttf", 32), NV)
T(draw, (M, y+42), "A Cross-Country Comparison", ff("WorkSans-Regular.ttf", 24), GD)
T(draw, (M+534, y+42), "·  2025 Data Report", ff("WorkSans-Regular.ttf", 19), GM)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Global Internet Usage Poster — Spatial Metrics philosophy.
A1 portrait: 3508 × 4967 px (150 DPI). ~90% vertical fill.
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import os

W, H = 3508, 4967
canvas = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), "#F7F9FB")
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)

FD = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"
_fc = {}
def ff(name, size):
    k = (name, size)
    if k not in _fc:
        _fc[k] = ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FD, name), size)
    return _fc[k]

# ── Palette ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
NV = "#091424"; ST = "#1E3048"; TL = "#0D7377"; CY = "#00ACC1"
EL = "#0077BE"; BG = "#F7F9FB"; WT = "#FFFFFF"; GL = "#D4DCE8"
GM = "#8899AA"; GD = "#556677"

M  = 148; CW = W - 2*M

# ── Primitives ────────────────────────────────────────────────
def T(dr, xy, txt, font, color):
    dr.text(xy, txt, font=font, fill=color)
def TR(dr, x, y, txt, font, color):
    b = dr.textbbox((0,0), txt, font=font)
    dr.text((x-(b[2]-b[0]), y), txt, font=font, fill=color)
def TC(dr, cx, y, txt, font, color):
    b = dr.textbbox((0,0), txt, font=font)
    dr.text((cx-(b[2]-b[0])/2, y), txt, font=font, fill=color)
def tw(txt, font):
    b = draw.textbbox((0,0), txt, font=font); return b[2]-b[0]
def tbase(txt, font):
    return draw.textbbox((0,0), txt, font=font)[3]
def BOX(dr, xy, fill=None, outline=None, w=1):
    dr.rectangle(xy, fill=fill, outline=outline, width=w)
def RULE(dr, x1, y1, x2, y2, color, w=1):
    dr.line([(x1,y1),(x2,y2)], fill=color, width=w)
def DOT(dr, cx, cy, r, fill=None):
    dr.ellipse([(cx-r,cy-r),(cx+r,cy+r)], fill=fill)
def ARC(dr, bbox, s, e, color, w=1):
    dr.arc(bbox, start=s, end=e, fill=color, width=w)

# ── Font reference ────────────────────────────────────────────
# BigShoulders-Bold: hero numerals (condensed, powerful)
# Outfit-Bold: section headers
# WorkSans-Regular: body text
# JetBrainsMono-Regular: data tables, labels
# CrimsonPro-Italic: accent lines, quotations

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# BACKGROUND — Globe & network motifs
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# Upper-right globe fragment
gx, gy = W - 190, 700
for r, asp, s, e in [(380,0.77,194,346),(470,0.77,198,342),(560,0.77,202,339),
                       (430,0.19,152,388),(510,0.17,157,383)]:
    ARC(draw, (gx-r, gy-r*asp, gx+r, gy+r*asp), s, e, GL, 1)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Global Internet Usage Poster — Spatial Metrics philosophy.
A1 portrait: 3508 × 4967 px (150 DPI). ~90% vertical fill.
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import os

W, H = 3508, 4967
canvas = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), "#F7F9FB")
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)

FD = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"
_fc = {}
def ff(name, size):
    k = (name, size)
    if k not in _fc:
        _fc[k] = ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FD, name), size)
    return _fc[k]

# ── Palette ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

    b = dr.textbbox((0,0), txt, font=font)
    dr.text((x-(b[2]-b[0]), y), txt, font=font, fill=color)
def TC(dr, cx, y, txt, font, color):
    b = dr.textbbox((0,0), txt, font=font)
    dr.text((cx-(b[2]-b[0])/2, y), txt, font=font, fill=color)
def tw(txt, font):
    b = draw.textbbox((0,0), txt, font=font); return b[2]-b[0]
def tbase(txt, font):
    return draw.textbbox((0,0), txt, font=font)[3]
def BOX(dr, xy, fill=None, outline=None, w=1):
    dr.rectangle(xy, fill=fill, outline=outline, width=w)
def RULE(dr, x1, y1, x2, y2, color, w=1):
    dr.line([(x1,y1),(x2,y2)], fill=color, width=w)
def DOT(dr, cx, cy, r, fill=None):
    dr.ellipse([(cx-r,cy-r),(cx+r,cy+r)], fill=fill)
def ARC(dr, bbox, s, e, color, w=1):
    dr.arc(bbox, start=s, end=e, fill=color, width=w)

steps.message:
Poster complete. Here's a summary of what was delivered:

**Output**: `/app/output/final_poster.png` — A1 portrait (3508×4967px, 150 DPI)

**Design Philosophy**: *Spatial Metrics* — treating numbers as architectural material, color as a load-distribution system, and space as the primary communication medium. The philosophy is documented at `/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/design_philosophy.md`.

**Poster structure** (top to bottom, ~89% vertical fill):
1. **Header** — Title, subtitle, date
2. **Hero** — "5.56 BILLION" as the dominant visual anchor, with 68% world penetration callout
3. **China & India panels** — Side-by-side callout highlighting ~1.09B and ~900M online populations
4. **Penetration rates bar chart** — 10-country ranked comparison with color-coded bars (electric blue → navy gradient) and 68% global average reference line with quartile tick marks
5. **Social media usage** — 143 minutes/day hero stat plus platform MAU rankings table
6. **Digital economy cards** — Three stat cards ($8.0T e-commerce, $800B+ AI market, >60% mobile traffic)
7. **Key takeaways** — Four bulleted insights with color-coded markers and source attribution

**Palette**: Deep navy (#091424), teal (#0D7377), electric blue (#0077BE), white, with subtle globe/network-node background motifs reinforcing the connectivity theme.
